description: Aggregate feedback statistics across many assets in ONE call - counts per asset and per version (v1, v2, ...), split by type (text/recording), tag, and author, with first/last feedback timestamps. Scope to a folder (folder_id), one asset (asset_id - an asset id or any of its version ids; the whole asset is reported, version by version), or the whole team; narrow the time window with from/to. Items are sorted by feedback count, most first; assets with no feedback in the window are left out unless include_empty is true. Paged: limit (default 50, max 200) and offset; total is the number of items, next_offset is set while more remain. Each item carries asset_id (the asset) and versions[], each with its version_id. Use this for trend questions like 'are v1 notes going down across this client's recent videos' or 'what tags dominate this folder' instead of calling feedback_list per asset. For reading the feedback text itself across assets, use recent_activity.

asset_id.description: Scope to one asset or version stack (mutually exclusive with folder_id)

folder_id.description: Scope to this folder's subtree (mutually exclusive with asset_id)

from.description: Only count feedback created at/after this ISO timestamp

include_empty.description: Also list assets with no feedback in the window (default false)

offset.description: Items to skip (use next_offset from the previous response)

to.description: Only count feedback created at/before this ISO timestamp

name: feedback_stats
title: Get feedback statistics
